name: Physics (PMn)

rules.name: Required Courses (minimum 20 units)
rules.desc:
Doctoral students seeking a minor in Physics must take at least six courses from the list below for 20 units.
Courses must be taken for a letter grade. A grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.3 (B+) must be maintained across courses counting towards the Ph.D. Minor.
All prospective minors must obtain approval for their Physics course program from the Physics Graduate Study Committee at least one year before the conferral of the PhD.
rules.notes:
You may only count up to 3 of the following courses towards the Ph.D. minor:

• PHYSICS230 - Graduate Quantum Mechanics I

• PHYSICS231 - Graduate Quantum Mechanics II

• PHYSICS234 - Advanced Topics in Quantum Mechanics

• PHYSICS330 - Quantum Field Theory I

• PHYSICS331 - Quantum Field Theory II

• PHYSICS332 - Quantum Field Theory III

limits.label: quantum mechanics and quantum field theory courses

rules.name: GPA of 3.3 (B+) across the minor's courses
Course program approved by the Physics Graduate Study Committee
Remaining units in Physics or Applied Physics

gpa: A GPA of 3.3 or higher must be maintained across all courses counting towards the Ph.D. Minor.
grading: All courses taken towards the PhD Minor must be taken for at least 3 units and receive a grade of B+ or higher.
policies: If students have taken at least 6 of the required courses, and have not met the 20 unit minimum, they may choose to take additional Applied Physics/Physics course(s) for letter grade, and a minimum 3 units to meet the unit minimum.
transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: You take six courses from the list, at most three of them quantum mechanics or quantum field theory, each for at least 3 units and a letter grade of B+ or better. If the six come to fewer than 20 units, more Physics or Applied Physics courses of 3+ units make up the rest. Your 3.3 GPA and the Graduate Study Committee's approval of your course program are checked by hand.
